title: Network analysis reveals that bHLH transcription factors positively regulate rice resistance to Magnaporthe oryzae.
authors: Ma, Linna; Liu, Yemei; Li, Feixue; Bai, Yusha; Li, Yingguang; Chen, Xiaoqi; Huang, Huichuan; Li, Xiang
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用泛基因组和时序转录组构建水稻bHLH转录因子与NLR基因的调控网络，但仅基于共表达和机器学习推断，缺乏蛋白-DNA三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题的TF-DNA结合机制研究关联较弱。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) and nucleotide-binding leucine-rich repeat (NLR) genes are core components of the immune response in rice against Magnaporthe oryzae. Although the construction of the rice pan-genome has provided new opportunities for dissecting the regulatory relationship between them, researchers still have limited systematic understanding of their interaction network during pathogen infection. In this study, we explored the interaction network between TFs and NLR genes by integrating the rice pan-genome with time-series transcriptomic data obtained at multiple time points during the rice-M. oryzae interaction. By combining weighted gene co-expression network analysis and the machine learning-based GENIE3 algorithm to construct TF-NLR interaction networks, we found that the bHLH TF family actively responds to M. oryzae infection and is widely involved in diverse biotic stress responses as well as the regulation of rice growth and development. To validate their biological functions, mutant rice lines were generated. Functional assays demonstrated that knockout of Os08g0490000, Os02g0726700, and Os01g0218100 significantly reduces rice resistance to M. oryzae infection (enhances susceptibility). Overall, this study highlights the importance of the bHLH TF family in rice immune responses through network-based analyses and identifies Os08g0490000 and Os01g0218100 as novel candidate genes associated with rice blast resistance. This study presents the first construction of a TF-NLR interaction network associated with rice blast resistance based on the rice pan-genome, providing new insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying rice-pathogen interactions. Furthermore, two novel bHLH-type resistance genes were identified, offering valuable genetic resources for rice improvement.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）和核苷酸结合亮氨酸重复序列（NLR）基因是水稻对稻瘟病菌（Magnaporthe oryzae）免疫反应的核心组成部分。尽管水稻泛基因组的构建为解析它们之间的调控关系提供了新机遇，但研究人员对其在病原菌感染过程中的相互作用网络仍缺乏系统性的理解。在本研究中，我们通过将水稻泛基因组与水稻-稻瘟病菌互作过程中多个时间点获得的时间序列转录组数据相结合，探索了TFs与NLR基因之间的相互作用网络。通过结合加权基因共表达网络分析和基于机器学习的GENIE3算法构建TF-NLR相互作用网络，我们发现bHLH转录因子家族对稻瘟病菌感染有积极响应，并广泛参与多种生物胁迫响应以及水稻生长发育的调控。为验证其生物学功能，我们生成了突变体水稻品系。功能实验表明，敲除Os08g0490000、Os02g0726700和Os01g0218100显著降低了水稻对稻瘟病菌感染的抗性（增强了感病性）。总体而言，本研究通过网络分析强调了bHLH转录因子家族在水稻免疫反应中的重要性，并鉴定出Os08g0490000和Os01g0218100为与稻瘟病抗性相关的新候选基因。本研究首次基于水稻泛基因组构建了与稻瘟病抗性相关的TF-NLR相互作用网络，为水稻-病原菌互作的分子机制提供了新见解。此外，还鉴定出两个新型bHLH型抗性基因，为水稻改良提供了宝贵的遗传资源。
